description: This file defines the LogicCriteria interface used for building and representing hierarchical criteria for querying within the OpenMRS project. It provides methods for constructing complex logical expressions, including conjunctions, disjunctions, transformations, and comparison operators, as well as retrieving the root token and logic parameters.

methods.name: appendExpression
methods.description: Creates and adds a new logical expression with a specified operator and operand to the current criteria, returning a new LogicCriteria object.

methods.name: applyTransform
methods.description: Applies a transformation operator (e.g., count, average) to the current logic criteria, returning an updated criteria object.

methods.name: appendCriteria
methods.description: Joins another LogicCriteria object with the current one using a specified logical operator, returning a combined criteria.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Combines the current LogicCriteria with another using logical AND, returning the combined criteria.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Combines the current LogicCriteria with another using logical OR, returning the combined criteria.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Negates the current LogicCriteria.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Adds a Count operator to the criteria, indicating counting of matching records.

methods.name: average
methods.description: Adds an Average operator to the criteria to compute the average of matching values.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Retrieves the last N results or applies the 'last' operator to the criteria.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Retrieves the first N results or applies the 'first' operator to the criteria.

methods.name: distinct
methods.description: Specifies that the query should return only distinct values.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks for the existence of matching records.

methods.name: notExists
methods.description: Checks for the non-existence of matching records.

methods.name: asOf
methods.description: Adds an 'AsOf' date filter to the criteria.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Adds a 'before' date filter to the criteria.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Adds an 'after' date filter to the criteria.

methods.name: in
methods.description: Filters the criteria to match values within a collection.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Adds a contains filter for string or operand matches.

methods.name: equalTo
methods.description: Adds an equality filter to the criteria for various data types.

methods.name: gte
methods.description: Adds a 'greater than or equal to' filter.

methods.name: gt
methods.description: Adds a 'greater than' filter.

methods.name: lt
methods.description: Adds a 'less than' filter.

methods.name: lte
methods.description: Adds a 'less than or equal to' filter.

methods.name: within
methods.description: Adds a duration-based filter to the criteria.

methods.name: getLogicParameters
methods.description: Retrieves the current logic parameters map.

methods.name: setLogicParameters
methods.description: Sets the logic parameters map.

methods.name: getRootToken
methods.description: Returns the root token (string) of the current LogicCriteria.

methods.name: getExpression
methods.description: Returns the LogicExpression object backing this criteria.
